description: This PHP source file defines the 'News' class within the Goteo framework. It manages news items including retrieval, listing, validation, saving, and banner management functions. The class interacts with a database to perform CRUD operations, handles multilingual support, and manages images associated with news entries.

classes.name: News
classes.description: Represents a news item with properties and methods to manage news entries, including multilingual content, image handling, ordering, and banner publication status within the Goteo framework.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific news item by its ID and language, joining with language-specific translation table.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of all news items for administrative purposes, ordered by their assigned order and title.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all news items, supporting multilingual content and optional highlighting of titles; also handles image retrieval.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the news item has a title and URL before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current news object to the database, including image handling and data validation.

methods.name: add_press_banner
methods.description: Marks a news item to appear in the press banner.

methods.name: remove_press_banner
methods.description: Removes a news item from the press banner.

methods.name: in_press_banner
methods.description: Checks if a news item is currently in the press banner.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves the news item up in the order for display purposes.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves the news item down in the order for display purposes.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for a new news item to be added at the end.
